errorBoundary.title: This view ran into a problem
errorBoundary.body: The error has been logged. The rest of ReadAware keeps working — you can try again.

errors.workspaceInvalid: The navigation target or selection is invalid.
errors.workspaceMissing: That page, collection, or selection is no longer available.
errors.workspaceChanged: The workspace changed. Check its current state before trying again.
errors.workspaceUnavailable: The workspace is not ready yet.
errors.workspaceTimeout: The destination did not finish opening.
errors.workspaceReadingPermission: Leaving the reader requires reading-control permission.
errors.workspaceObserverLimit: Too many workspace subscriptions are active.
errors.readingTimeInvalid: Check the book, calendar day and session page limits.
errors.readingTimeStale: Reading statistics are still recovering. Try again when recovery finishes.
errors.readingTimeUnavailable: Reading time could not be loaded.
errors.readingTimeLimit: Close another live reading-time view before opening this one.
errors.bookRemovalCleanupPending: The books were removed, but local file cleanup did not finish.
errors.bookRemovalReappeared: A book is present again. Its files were not released.
errors.bookCleanupInvalid: The file cleanup query is invalid.
errors.bookCleanupStale: The library is still recovering. Try file cleanup again after recovery finishes.
errors.bookSearchCancelled: The book text search was cancelled.
errors.bookSearchInvalid: Check the search queries and limits, then try again.
errors.bookNotFound: This book is no longer in the library.
errors.pluginActionDisabled: This plugin action is not currently available.
errors.bookTextExtractionFailed: Some book text could not be prepared. Try again to resume unfinished sections.
errors.bookTextUnsupported: This book does not provide supported text sections for chapter indexing.
errors.bookTextCancelled: This text preparation request was cancelled.
errors.bookTextBusy: Text preparation is already running. Wait for it to finish before rebuilding.
errors.bookTextTaskNotFound: This text request is no longer available to this caller.
errors.bookTextTaskLimit: Too many text requests or observers are active. Finish or cancel existing requests first.
errors.settingsInvalidShortcut: Choose a valid key and optional modifiers. Escape is reserved for closing overlays.
errors.settingsShortcutConflict: That shortcut is already assigned. Choose another combination or update the conflicting bindings together.
errors.readerPlaybackFailed: Read aloud stopped because audio could not be played. Try again or choose another voice.
errors.readerSegmentationFailed: The reading mode could not prepare this passage. Turn the mode off and on to try again.
errors.annotationConflict: This annotation changed. Read it again before applying your changes.
errors.annotationUnavailable: Annotation storage is not available in this environment.
errors.annotationCancelled: The annotation change was cancelled before it was submitted.
errors.annotationNotFound: This annotation no longer exists or is a different type.
errors.annotationInvalidInput: The annotation request contains an invalid value.
errors.annotationForbidden: Only the reading assistant can record a question trace.
errors.bookEncryption: This book is encrypted or DRM-protected and cannot be opened. Use an unprotected copy.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Details are in the app log.
errors.fsNotFound: A file ReadAware needs is missing.
errors.fsPermission: ReadAware doesn't have permission to access a needed file.
errors.fsNoSpace: The disk is full. Free up space and try again.
errors.dbLocked: The local database is busy. Try again in a moment.
errors.dbError: The local database ran into a problem.
errors.secretsUnavailable: The credential store can't be opened, so keys can't be saved or read.
errors.aiNotConfigured: AI isn't set up yet — add an API key to start chatting.
errors.aiLocalOnly: Local-only mode has disabled AI requests. You can change this in AI settings.
errors.aiMemoryDisabled: Building memory is disabled. You can enable it in AI settings.
errors.aiContextChanged: Reading privacy settings changed, so this request was stopped. Try again with the current settings.
errors.aiContextWithheld: This action needs reading text that your privacy settings withhold. Review AI privacy settings to continue.
errors.aiInvalidReadingContext: This action supplied invalid reading context. Update the app or plugin before trying again.
errors.aiAuth: The AI provider rejected the API key. Check it in Settings.
errors.aiRateLimited: The AI provider is limiting requests right now. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.aiQuota: Your AI account is out of credit or quota. Check your provider account.
errors.aiNetwork: Couldn't reach the AI provider. Check your connection and try again.
errors.aiProvider: The AI provider had a temporary problem. Try again shortly.
errors.aiContextOverflow: This request is too large for the model.
errors.aiUnknown: The AI request failed. Details are in the app log.
errors.syncNetwork: Can't reach the sync server. It will retry automatically.
errors.syncServer: The sync server is temporarily unavailable. It will retry automatically.
errors.syncRateLimited: Syncing is being rate-limited. It will retry automatically.
errors.syncUnauthorized: Your sync session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.syncMisdirected: The sync server address answered as a different service. Check the relay URL.
errors.syncPassphrase: The end-to-end encryption passphrase doesn't match.
errors.syncTransportUnavailable: The plugin providing this sync connection isn't available. Enable the plugin, then try again.
errors.syncTransportMismatch: The sync plugin's server settings changed after connecting. Reconnect to adopt the new server.
errors.syncLogIncomplete: This device is still filling in the account's history from the server. Try again once sync has caught up.
errors.syncCheckpointMismatch: The account snapshot was made by a different version of ReadAware and was ignored. Sync will rebuild from the full history instead.
errors.syncCheckpointPrecondition: A checkpoint could not be saved right now because some changes are still waiting to sync. It will be retried automatically.
errors.localSaveFailed: This change couldn't be written to local storage and may be lost after a restart.

crashPrompt.title: ReadAware had a problem last time
crashPrompt.body: Sending a diagnostics report helps get it fixed.
